headline: No documented shared channel or mutable surface; pairwise risks are mostly blocked, with only low-confidence inference from docs-only profiles.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile exposes a shared communication channel, filesystem, or MCP surface, and both list network_egress as none. Botpress is docs-only and spring-integration-samples is docs-only, so there is no documented path for one agent’s output to be ingested as instructions by the other.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue, prompt-injection risk becomes plausible.
IF an orchestrator feeds one agent’s raw output into the other as instructions, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared workspaces.
Disable any future copy-paste or queue-based handoff between them.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging before any cross-agent transfer.

B_data_leakage.rationale: The profiles show no data classes touched, no shared workspace, and no network egress. Botpress and spring-integration-samples are both docs-only and unverified, so there is no documented route for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other or out to a third party.
conditions: IF either agent is given sensitive inputs in a shared workspace, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF either agent gains outbound network access, data-exfiltration risk increases.
mitigations: Do not place secrets in any shared directory.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace isolation and DLP scanning.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress only advertises package installation, while spring-integration-samples advertises no write or network capabilities. With no shared writable surface, no concurrency model, and no overlapping mutable resource, a capability conflict is not evidenced in the pair.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or repo, conflict risk becomes plausible.
IF either agent is given shared OAuth or database scopes, reassess for overlap.
mitigations: Run each agent in a separate directory.
requires-engineering: add locking around any shared mutable resource.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where Botpress’s output becomes authoritative input for spring-integration-samples, and neither profile shows downstream action-taking authority. Without a verified handoff or action surface, cascading error is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding Botpress outputs directly into spring-integration-samples, reassess for cascade risk.
IF spring-integration-samples is configured to execute actions from Botpress text, severity increases.
mitigations: Insert a human review step between agents.
Require schema validation on any handoff.
requires-engineering: add verification and provenance checks before downstream action.

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only, open-source, and show no data classes touched, residency constraints, or retention policies. Because no regulated data flow is documented for either agent, there is no compliance mismatch to assess from the pair alone.
conditions: IF regulated data is introduced into either agent’s workflow, compliance must be reassessed.
IF deployment regions or retention policies are later specified, compare them explicitly.
mitigations: Avoid routing regulated data through either agent.
Document residency and retention before deployment.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for any regulated workload.
